name: reschedule_appointment
description: After explicit confirmation, CALL THIS TOOL IMMEDIATELY. Copy appointment_id, practitioner_id, branch_id, appointment_type_id, and start_time unchanged from the most recent rescheduling search_availability result. Reuse the established caller_full_name. Do not ask for another confirmation and do not report an error unless this tool returns ok=false.

appointment_id.description: Exact appointment_id echoed by the most recent rescheduling search_availability result.

practitioner_id.description: Exact practitioner_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

branch_id.description: Exact branch_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

appointment_type_id.description: Exact appointment_type_id from the confirmed replacement slot.

start_time.description: Exact start_time from the confirmed replacement slot; do not derive it from spoken time.
